title: Applied labs
description: Build, break, debug and evaluate in your own environment.

lessons.title: Lab: Vision-language models
lessons.conceptOverview: Compare retrieval for a whole-page image and cropped regions. Record where chart labels or small text disappear and explain the resolution tradeoff.
lessons.whyItMatters: Connect vision, documents, audio and retrieval.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: CLIP-style learning aligns image and text representations using paired examples. A vision encoder produces features; a projection layer can map them into the language-model embedding space as visual tokens. Image resolution and tiling affect token count, latency and small-text recognition.

sections.title: 1. Establish a baseline
sections.content: Write down your inputs, expected behavior and constraints before starting. Compare retrieval for a whole-page image and cropped regions. Record where chart labels or small text disappear and explain the resolution tradeoff.

sections.title: 2. Introduce a failure
sections.content: Test the mistaken assumption: More image tokens guarantee correct visual reasoning. Record the observed result and the point where it diverges from your prediction.

sections.title: 3. Debug and evaluate
sections.content: Use the mechanism to explain the failure: CLIP-style learning aligns image and text representations using paired examples. A vision encoder produces features; a projection layer can map them into the language-model embedding space as visual tokens. Image resolution and tiling affect token count, latency and small-text recognition. Change one variable at a time. Repeat the baseline and add a held-out case. Submit the implementation, results and limitations.

commonMistakes: More image tokens guarantee correct visual reasoning.
keyTakeaways: CLIP-style learning aligns image and text representations using paired examples.

lessons.title: Lab: Document, audio & video pipelines
lessons.conceptOverview: Design an extraction schema for a scanned invoice and an audio transcript. Include uncertainty, source positions and a human-review condition for each field.
lessons.whyItMatters: Connect vision, documents, audio and retrieval.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Document AI combines OCR, layout detection and table or form structure. Preserve page and bounding-box provenance. Speech recognition transcribes audio, diarization separates speakers, and TTS synthesizes speech. Video pipelines sample frames and retain timestamps; sparse sampling can miss short events.

lessons.title: Lab: Multimodal RAG
lessons.conceptOverview: Build a small corpus of chart images and captions. Compare text-only retrieval with image-plus-text retrieval using a labeled question set. Track citation accuracy.
lessons.whyItMatters: Connect vision, documents, audio and retrieval.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Index text, image and document representations with source metadata. Retrieve compatible representations, rerank candidates and provide the original evidence to the answer generator. Cross-modal similarity requires an aligned embedding space. Evaluate retrieval separately from extraction and answer faithfulness.
